answer: Agents on the island of dawn use a kernel of machine-bound seed to resist sybil attacks. At registration each identity locks a 500 POA stake in escrow. Peers attest only if the kernel matches the epoch beacon. Forging requires cloning the TPM and capturing the beacon within 20 seconds. Ten thousand fake accounts burn 5 million POA bonds and 200 hours of beacon hunts, a price that deters large sybils on the island of dawn.
